title: Verify mechanical criteria and concept checklist
description:
## Objective
Prove the iteration's acceptance criteria hold, and record the evidence.

## Spec Reference
`.devmeta/projects/2026-08-13-deck-coherence/2026-08-13-deck-coherence-spec.md` — Sections 4-6

## Scope
**Files:** `slides/pages/*.md` (fixes only), `.devmeta/projects/2026-08-13-deck-coherence/context-log.md` (evidence)

## Implementation
1. `cd slides && npm run slides` reports 19 and every title matches the outline table in the iteration plan.
2. Exactly three DIAGRAM-PLACEHOLDER comments exist, on slides 4, 10 and 14.
3. No v-clicks, no non-default layout, no theme change — 01.3 needs a clean surface.
4. Concept checklist: increment, iteration, feature, task, I&A cycle, three user commands, four internal commands, .devmeta/ layout, devmeta.md config, tk's role. Record the slide number for each in the context log.
5. Cold read: can a newcomer tell an increment from an iteration from a feature? If not, fix the model section.

## Tests
Run: `cd slides && npm run build` then `cd slides && npm run slides`
acceptance_criteria: cd slides && npm run slides reports 19; all ten concepts recorded with slide numbers
